name: New York
licensingAuthorityNote: Registered nurses in New York are licensed by the New York State Education Department's Office of the Professions (NYSED). PermitBridge does not cover trade licenses (electrical, plumbing, HVAC, contracting) for New York.

faqs.question: How do registered nurses licensed in another state get licensed in New York?
faqs.answer: By endorsement through NYSED's Office of the Professions. NYSED's endorsement page lists Form 1 (Application for Licensure) with the $143 fee, Form 2 (Certification of Professional Education), and Form 3 or Nursys verification of every other license held. NYSED also notes that New York is not a Nursing Compact state.
